newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Peruvian jailed for five years for stealing $1.45.
newsitem.headline: Peruvian jailed for five years for stealing $1.45.

text.p: An Argentine court sentenced a Peruvian immigrant to five years in prison on Thursday for stealing $1.45.
The court found 26 year-old Alfredo Toledo Flores threatened a young woman with a kitchen knife and robbed her, local media reported.
Judge Alejandro Sanudo said the sentence applied was the minimum under Argentine law for armed robbery and that he could have jailed Toledo Flores for 15 years.
"We applied the minimum sentence because obviously (the law) is pretty severe," he said.
The judge rejected arguments by the defence that Toledo Flores was not responsible for his actions because he was drunk when he carried out the robbery.
